messages:
Maria: prod model pulls started failing in eu-west1 around 10:12. App logs show Envoy returning 503 and connection resets to s3.amazonaws.com. Anyone seeing this?
Akash: seeing the same on gpu-pool-2, CPU is fine but LB 502/504 spike. Suspect SNAT port exhaustion from a sudden fanout of short connections. :thinking: 
Elena: digging into node metrics now — conntrack table entries are high, CLOSE_WAITs rising.
Kevin: FYI we rolled out a tighter mesh egress policy last night that enforces SNI host allowlist on the egress gateway. Could be blocking TLS to S3 if SNI doesn't match.
Maria: interesting — direct IP to S3 (bypassing envoy) returns 200. TLS handshake fails through envoy with 'no matching filter chain' in envoy logs.
Akash: quick mitigation: increasing node ephemeral port range + bumping TCP keepalive on model-fetcher reduces new socket churn. Doing that on one node now.
Elena: running this to confirm conntrack pressure: `kubectl debug node/$NODE -- conntrack -S | grep ESTABLISHED` — got ~18k established on the busy node.
Kevin: I can push a canary policy that adds `*.s3.amazonaws.com` to the egress SNI allowlist. But need approvals for global wildcard.
Maria: please canary to eu-west1 only first. This is blocking customer workloads.
deploy-bot: started rollout: mesh-egress-allowlist v2026-03-23-canary -> clusters: eu-west1 (1/1).
Akash: after canary applied, model pulls on that node recovered immediately. Latency back to normal. :thumbsup:
Elena: will keep conntrack monitoring; also adding a conntrack alert threshold to avoid recurrence.
Kevin: follow-up action items: 1) Add s3 wildcard to egress allowlist 2) Add automated ephemeral-port tuning for bursty pods 3) Update model-fetcher to use keepalive + connection pooling 4) Add doc for mesh egress SNI requirements.
Maria: creating a short runbook entry for incident mitigation and linking to the PR.
oncall-bot: incident created: INC-2026-2372 - mesh-egress SNI allowlist caused S3 model pull failures (severity: P2).
infra-bot: note: consider adding an egress gateway health probe that tests SNI hostnames for major external dependencies (s3, model-registry, auth).
Kevin: thanks team. I'll open the PR for the canary->global rollout and include risk notes about SNI wildcards.
Maria: closing the thread when PR merged and monitoring stable for 2 hours. Thanks everyone!
